description: This file implements a function 'runCallsiteGuard' that performs static analysis on a set of TypeScript files within a repository. It collects files, reads their content, identifies specific call lines as per provided parameters, and reports violations. The code relies on utility functions for path resolution and file collection.

methods.name: runCallsiteGuard
methods.description: Asynchronously collects TypeScript files and checks for callsite violations based on provided parameters. Reports violations and exits process if any are found.
